images.name: German Spitz, Giant
images.prompt: Create an original refined naturalistic field-guide portrait, native actual1536x1024 landscape. One mature adult German Giant Spitz (Grossspitz), standard white coat, a medium-sized balanced sturdy square spitz around45cm at shoulder, in a relaxed side-biased three-quarter standing pose at dog-eye level on a firm earthy country path with muted distant hedgerow, diffuse late-afternoon light. Foxlike moderate wedge-shaped head, muzzle neither stubby nor long, close-fitting dark lips, black nose, medium dark almond eyes; small pointed triangular upright ears high and close set, never giant bat ears. Long straight firm stand-off outer coat over dense undercoat, strong mane-like neck ruff, short smooth facial and front-leg hair, moderate rear feathering, natural fur not rounded sculpted Pomeranian fluff. Clearly defined straight mature legs, small compact round feet. Complete natural medium-length very bushy tail visibly attached high at rear, rising directly from root and curling forward firmly over the back; full tail tip inside frame and distinct from ruff. Entire dog with all four coherent grounded paws, complete ears and tail fully visible with comfortable crop-safe margins. Subtle painterly realism and tactile coat detail; restrained credible rural setting. No people, other animals, gear, collar, text, logos or watermark; no toy-Pomeranian apple head, Keeshond grey mask or oversized heavy Samoyed proportions. profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Attentive and strongly attached to its people, the Giant German Spitz often combines a lively manner with reserve toward strangers. Its keen hearing and watchful loyalty have long been valued around homes and property. The black variety has a particularly vivid working history in Württemberg vineyards, where it deterred birds and other animals by day and guarded against grape thieves at night.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Lively and loyal, the Giant German Spitz often stays watchful around its home and reserved with unfamiliar people.
